# Running plan 2025-07

Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Iris joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day. Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 3000 kilometres.

New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat. Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast. Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
